bullets:
Vectors must be normalized
before calculate similarity
Their Lengths = 1
It is a dot product between two Normalized vectors a and b
labels: 23 (slide number, black text in yellow oval, top-right corner)
Normalize (red italic text inside the block arrow between the two circles)
equations: \boldsymbol{a} . \boldsymbol{b} = \boldsymbol{a}^T \boldsymbol{b} = |\boldsymbol{a}|\,|\boldsymbol{b}|\cos(\theta)   (plain text: a . b = a^T b = |a| |b| cos(θ))

\cos(\theta) = \dfrac{\boldsymbol{a}^T \boldsymbol{b}}{|\boldsymbol{a}|\,|\boldsymbol{b}|} = \boldsymbol{a}^T \boldsymbol{b}   (plain text: cos(θ) = (a^T b)/(|a| |b|) = a^T b, with cos(θ) in red bold)

layout.arrangement: Light-gray slide with a dark-red border frame. Red bold title centered at top; small yellow slide-number oval '23' in the top-right corner. Two large pale-yellow circle diagrams (vector geometry) sit side by side at mid-height: left diagram at far left, right diagram at right-center. A red-outlined block arrow labeled 'Normalize' points right between them at mid-height. A white blue-bordered callout box sits top-center (between title and right circle); a white blue-bordered equations box sits top-right; another white blue-bordered equations box sits bottom-center; a white blue-bordered 'After Normalization' box sits bottom-right. A full-width light-cyan summary bar spans the bottom, and below it two small boxes: yellow 'Maximize...' (left) and pink 'Loss = -[Similarity]' (right).

layout.hierarchy: Visually dominant: (1) the two large pale-yellow circle diagrams occupying the middle band; (2) the red bold title at top; (3) the full-width cyan summary bar as a strong color block at bottom; (4) medium-weight white bordered boxes with equations/callouts; (5) smallest: vector labels a/b/θ, the 'Normalize' arrow text, and the '23' badge.

visual_elements.description: Left vector-geometry diagram: pale-yellow filled circle centered on black coordinate axes (horizontal and vertical lines with arrowheads on both ends, extending past the circle). Blue vector labeled 'b' (bold italic) starts at origin and points up-right at roughly 60-65 degrees above horizontal, reaching ~60% of the circle radius. Red vector labeled 'a' (bold italic) starts at origin and points right, ~15-18 degrees above horizontal, reaching ~85% of the radius. A small green arc near the origin between the vectors is labeled 'θ' (green bold italic).

Right vector-geometry diagram: identical pale-yellow circle with black double-headed axes; blue vector 'b' at ~55-60 degrees, red vector 'a' at ~12-15 degrees, green angle arc 'θ' near origin. A small gray pencil/pen annotation cursor icon rests at the lower-right inside the circle (~4-5 o'clock position).

Horizontal block arrow (PowerPoint 'Right Block Arrow' shape) pointing right, white/very light fill with red outline, containing the red italic word 'Normalize'. It visually transforms the left (unnormalized) diagram into the right (normalized) diagram.
visual_elements.position: center between the two circles, ~40%-50% width, ~42%-53% height

visual_elements.description: Top-center callout: white rectangle with ~2pt blue border, three centered lines: 'Vectors must be normalized' (word 'normalized' bold blue), 'before calculate similarity', 'Their Lengths = 1'.

Top-right equations box: white rectangle with blue border containing two italic-serif equations with stacked fractions: 'Normalized a = a/|a|' and 'Normalized b = b/|b|', where a and b are bold-italic and underlined.

Bottom-center equations box: white rectangle with blue border, two lines: 'a . b = a^T b = |a| |b| cos(θ)' (bold-italic vectors, black cos) and 'cos(θ) = (a^T b)/(|a| |b|) = a^T b' with 'cos(θ)' in bold red and a stacked fraction in the middle.
Bottom-right box: white rectangle with blue border, two lines: 'After Normalization' and '|a| = |b| = 1' (bold-italic a and b).

Full-width summary bar: light-cyan rectangle with blue border; line 1 bold blue larger text 'Cosine Similarity is between -1 , +1'; line 2 blue text 'It is a dot product between two Normalized vectors a and b' with 'dot' underlined and 'a', 'b' bold.
Bottom-left yellow rectangle with red border, black sans-serif text: 'Maximize [Similarity] = Minimize -[Similarity]'.
Bottom-right pink rectangle with red border, red bold text: 'Loss = -[Similarity]'.
Slide-number badge: small yellow filled oval with thin outline containing the number '23' in black.

imagery: Small gray pencil/pen annotation cursor icon at the lower-right inside the right circle diagram (~4-5 o'clock position), pointing down-left; it is a presenter pen annotation, not content.
No photographs or illustrations otherwise; all visuals are vector shapes, arrows, and text boxes.

typography_notes: Title: bold sans-serif (Arial-like), ~32-36pt, red, title case with colon. Body/callout text: sans-serif ~16-18pt; key words bold ('normalized', 'Cosine Similarity is between -1 , +1'); 'dot' underlined; 'a' and 'b' bold in the cyan bar. Equations: italic serif (Times/Cambria-Math style) with bold-italic vector letters; 'a' and 'b' in the top-right box are underlined; stacked fractions with horizontal bars; superscript T for transpose. 'Normalize' in the arrow is red italic. 'Loss = -[Similarity]' is red bold. No traditional bullet glyphs anywhere — all content lives in bordered text boxes. Vector labels a, b, θ are bold italic.
animation_state: No mid-build state; every element is fully visible. The gray pencil icon on the right circle is a presenter pen/cursor annotation, not a build artifact.
